items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: one of my very favorite bass players and people is Henry Franklin who was Hugh Masekela’s bass player. Anyway, yeah Henry!

ctx.x: Wow. I’ve noticed that — I never noticed it with bass players but I noticed it with people like Hugh Masekela, the South African musicians, they seem to be above the pitch. But I’m not sure my ears can hear a bit of sharpness from a bassist. But I guess yours can.

Well it’s almost like just a little — it’s almost more like a feeling than it really being sharp. And also one of my very favorite bass players and people is Henry Franklin who was Hugh Masekela’s bass player. Anyway, yeah Henry!

Yeah. How about that? I love Masekela’s music. We almost stumbled upon this question that I have on my list here and that was the concept of time between bassists and drummers. Do you have people you’ve played with over the years where you really felt like we are locked in and on the other hand people that you never seem to be able to lock in with?
